captains_call.title: Watcher stand-down policy
captains_call.about: Watcher auto-standdown was restored in #6; two homes still idle-loop overnight.
captains_call.decide: Keep auto-standdown, or switch to an explicit captain-armed watch?
captains_call.context:
Option A — keep auto-standdown (recommended)
• Changes nothing further; #6 already restored it and main CI passes.
• Cost: a watcher may stand down during a slow PR and miss one landing until the next /bearings.

Option B — captain-armed watch
• Watchers run only when you arm them from the board.
• Cost: one extra tap per session; overnight idle loops stop entirely.

Why now: secondmate-2 burned ~40 idle polls last night.
Done already: <script>alert(1)</script> leak probe merged; tests realigned.
Would falsify A: another missed landing this week.
